_doc: Seasonal atmosphere (story 16.19, AD-31, CAP-35/30). `cover`: the snow cover (0..1) rises over `rise` seconds while it snows, holds at `hold` in the `seasons` listed (a winter day keeps some snow on roofs) and melts over `melt` seconds in other seasons; roof tiles, kerbs, hedges and tree crowns each turn white at their own threshold (`soft` is how wide that ramp is), so the cover builds up tile by tile. `sparkle`: glints on covered roofs (`life` seconds, `rate` per second at full cover). `frost`: the screen edge frosts in winter (`winter`, stronger while `snowing`), `reach` is the deepest frost in base px, `steps` its flat levels. `heat`: the shimmer over dark paved pixels in clear weather, `seasons` give the strength of a season, `from`..`to` (game minutes, ramped over `ramp`) the hot hours; Low and Canvas draw `wisps` instead. `rays`: light beams under tree crowns, `weather` gives each state's share, they fade out as it darkens (`fadeFrom`..`fadeTo` of the light map's darkness). Every layer eases over its `fade` seconds. The switches per tier are `atmosphere` in quality.json.
